description: Fuaran apply-engine conformance corpus. SELF-ENUMERATED: this family is deliberately not indexed by the corpus root manifest.json, which indexes the canonical wire-format codec families only — the laws/, dag/, merge-conformance/ and devtools-relay/ precedent. `adoption` is per host and is DATA: a host whose entry reads `proposed` reports the family BY NAME rather than skipping it silently, and flips its own entry to `adopted` in the change-set that lands its leg. This manifest is authoritative for the vector count; do not restate one in prose.

families.description: Apply-time node-id uniqueness: an op that puts nodes in (ReplaceRoot, EditNode, UpdateState, InsertChild, a Batch of them) and leaves an id it installed held twice is refused with DuplicateNodeId, including an installed id colliding with a pre-existing node; restating an id the op removes in the same act, a duplicate the op did not install, and a Batch whose intermediate state repeats an id but whose result does not, all apply. LimitExceeded takes precedence where an op breaches both.

The skeleton-op apply contract over the witness surface: accept with the result's canonical bytes and hash, or reject with the class, per validator clause per op, plus Batch atomicity and the id-collision shapes.

Apply-time WireLimits over host wire trees: an EditNode or UpdateState that puts a subtree in, or a MoveNode that stacks two legal depths, past MaxDepth is refused with LimitExceeded, and the same op landing exactly at the limit applies; plus the repeated-id shape an id-set derivation would wave through. `proposed` marks a host whose apply engine enforces no apply-time limit yet.
